nodes.title: Transaction Notification Service
nodes.summary: This service enables merchants to receive notifications about payments by setting up a POST Webhook endpoint in their Squad Dashboard.

nodes.title: Expected Webhook Response
nodes.summary: This outlines the expected HTTP status codes (200, 400, 500) and sample JSON payloads for webhook responses indicating successful receipt or failure.

nodes.title: Webhook Validation --version 1
nodes.summary: This section describes the first version of webhook validation methods, including hash comparison and decryption of the encrypted body.

nodes.title: Method 1 (Hash Comparison)
nodes.summary: This method validates webhooks by comparing an HMAC-SHA512 hash generated from the notification body with the 'x-squad-signature' in the request header.

nodes.title: Sample Implementations
nodes.summary: This section lists programming languages for which sample implementations of webhook hash comparison are provided.

nodes.title: Method 2 (Decryption of Encrypted Body)
nodes.summary: This method validates webhooks by decrypting the 'encrypted_body' using the merchant's Public and Secret Keys and comparing it to the original payload.

nodes.title: Sample Webhook Notification
nodes.summary: This provides a sample JSON structure of a webhook notification, including transaction details and an encrypted body.

nodes.title: Webhook Validation --version 2
nodes.summary: Webhook Version 2 (V2) introduces a version number field and a new hash validation method focusing on six specific fields separated by a pipe character.

nodes.title: Webhook Validation --version 3
nodes.summary: Webhook Version 3 (V3) updates the transaction reference format, adds a version number, and maintains hash validation on six specific pipe-separated fields.

nodes.title: Sample signature string
nodes.summary: This provides an example of how the signature string is constructed by concatenating specific payload fields with pipe separators.

nodes.title: Sample v2 and v3 notifications
nodes.summary: This section provides sample JSON payloads for both Webhook Version 2 and Version 3 notifications, illustrating their structure and new fields.

nodes.title: C# Sample Implementation for Webhook Validation V3
nodes.summary: This C# code snippet demonstrates how to generate and compare an HMAC-SHA512 hash for Webhook Validation Version 3.

nodes.title: PHP Sample Implementation for Webhook Validation V3
nodes.summary: This PHP code snippet demonstrates how to generate and compare an HMAC-SHA512 hash for Webhook Validation Version 3.

nodes.title: Javascript Sample Implementation for Webhook Validation V3
nodes.summary: This Javascript code snippet demonstrates how to generate and compare an HMAC-SHA512 hash for Webhook Validation Version 3.

nodes.title: Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This API allows merchants to retrieve and manage missed webhook notifications to update their records and prevent duplicate transactions.

nodes.title: Get Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This API endpoint allows fetching an array of missed webhook notifications from the error log.

nodes.title: Description for Get Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This API returns an array of the top 100 missed webhook transactions, enabling merchants to update their records.

nodes.title: Parameters for Get Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This section lists the query parameters required for retrieving webhook error logs.

nodes.title: Query Parameters for Get Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This details the 'page' and 'perPage' query fields for pagination when retrieving webhook error logs.

nodes.title: Responses for Get Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible API responses, including success and unauthorized errors, for retrieving webhook error logs.

nodes.title: Delete Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This API endpoint allows deleting a processed transaction from the webhook error log.

nodes.title: Description for Delete Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This API enables you to remove a processed transaction from the error log, preventing it from being returned in subsequent queries.

nodes.title: Parameters for Delete Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This section lists the path parameters required for deleting webhook error logs.

nodes.title: Path Parameters for Delete Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This details the 'transaction_ref' path field used to identify the specific transaction to delete from the webhook error log.

nodes.title: Responses for Delete Webhook Error Log
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible API responses, including success, unauthorized, and forbidden errors, for deleting webhook error logs.

nodes.title: Query Transactions Using Customer Identifier

nodes.summary: This endpoint queries transactions for a specific customer by replacing a placeholder in the URL with their unique identifier.

nodes.summary: This section lists the path parameters required for querying transactions using a customer identifier.

nodes.title: Path Parameters for Query Transactions Using Customer Identifier
nodes.summary: This details the 'customer_identifier' path field used to identify the customer whose transactions are to be queried.

nodes.title: Query All Merchant Transactions with Multiple Filters

nodes.title: Query Parameters for Query All Merchant Transactions with Multiple Filters
nodes.summary: This details the various query fields including pagination, virtual account number, customer identifier, date ranges, transaction reference, session ID, and sorting direction.

nodes.title: Responses for Query All Merchant Transactions with Multiple Filters
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible API responses, including success and various error types, for querying all merchant transactions with multiple filters.
